POLICE HEADQUARTERS,
Macau, 7th de November de 1939
No. S. L. D. 9464
Date 11 / 11 / 39

Exmo. Sr.

Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your letter
No. D9454 dated 11th October, 1939 and to inform you that a
party of Russian gipsy families left for Shanghai on the
5th instant by S. S. "Yu-Sang" from Hong Kong.

They all possess inoculation certificates against chol-
era and small-pox issued by the Macau Health Authorities.

An old woman, Marie Yanoff, age 95 is left behind for
medical treatment in San Rafael Hospital and will return to
Shanghai when she has completely recovered from illness.

Thanking you for your co-operation in this matter.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Lieut.) Julio Montalvão e Silva
Actg. Commissioner of Police

K. M. Bourne Esq.
Commissioner of Police
Shanghai

P.S. Since writing above, information reached me that the
woman, Marie Yanoff has passed away.

（批：Dc (Sp B-)
Dc (C-)）

日期 1939年11月11日

尊敬的先生：

阁下，

谨此确认收到阁下1939年10月11日发出的第D9454号来函，并告知阁下，一批俄罗斯吉普赛家庭已于本月5日乘“Yu-Sang”号轮船从香港启程前往上海。

他们均持有由澳门卫生当局签发的霍乱和天花疫苗接种证书。

一名95岁的老妇人玛丽·亚诺夫（Marie Yanoff）因需接受治疗而留在圣拉斐尔医院（San Rafael Hospital），待其完全康复后将返回上海。

感谢阁下在此事上的合作。

谨致
敬礼，

（中尉）胡里奥·蒙塔尔瓦奥·伊·席尔瓦（Julio Montalvão e Silva）

上海

Section 1, Special Branch,
October 9, 1939.

Communication dated 21-9-39 from the Macau Police concerning a
group of Russian gypsies.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

Members of the three Russian gypsy families mentioned
in the attached communication from the Macau police are reported
to have been residing in Shanghai for several years and are regis-
tered with the Russian Migrants Committee. On 1-5-39, in con-
nection with their application for visas to Macau, George S.
STANESKO, Ilya V. STANESKO and Alexis I. STANESKO, the respective
heads of the said families, were issued by the Committee with
certificates to the effect that they and members of their families
enumerated in each certificate are duly registered with the
Committee.

These people are known to have been working locally as
musicians, singers, dancers, fortune tellers etc. On the whole
gypsies in Shanghai do not enjoy a good reputation.

Three of the group in question are, in all probability,
identical with the undermentioned individuals who have come to
the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with criminal
activities:-

1. STANESKO, Gregory. Musician.
On 23-11-37 he was sentenced by the 1st S.S.D.Court to
2 months imprisonment on a charge of Larceny by Trick (C.R.C.
No. 2859).

2. STANESKO, Pavlena
Wife of Alexis Stanesko. On 9-1-29 she was charged at
the French Mixed Court with Begging and was cautioned. On 14-11-36
she was brought before the 1st S.S.D.Court on a charge of Fraud
and was sentenced to 30 days detention. (C.R.C. No. 1271).

3. STANESKO, Stepan. Musician.
He was arrested by the S.M.P. in June, 1932 on suspicion
of having participated with another gypsy in a Larceny by Trick
(ringing the changes), but owing to lack of evidence he was re-
leased. (Louza F.I.R. 1300/32).

特务科第一股，
1939年10月9日。

关于澳门警方提及一群俄罗斯吉普赛人的1939年9月21日来函。
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

据报，附件中澳门警方来函所提及的三个俄罗斯吉普赛家庭的成员已在上海居住数年，并在俄罗斯移民委员会登记。1939年5月1日，就其申请澳门签证一事，上述各家庭的家长乔治·S·斯塔内斯科（George S. STANESKO）、伊利亚·V·斯塔内斯科（Ilya V. STANESKO）和阿列克谢·I·斯塔内斯科（Alexis I. STANESKO）获该委员会颁发证书，证明他们及其各自证书中所列的家庭成员均已在该委员会正式登记。

据悉，这些人在本地从事音乐家、歌手、舞者、算命师等工作。总体而言，上海的吉普赛人名声不佳。

该群体中的三人极有可能与下述因涉及犯罪活动而引起工部局警务处注意的人员为同一人：-

1. 斯塔内斯科，格雷戈里（STANESKO, Gregory）。音乐家。
1937年11月23日，他因诈骗罪（C.R.C. 第2859号）被第一特区地方法院判处监禁两个月。

2. 斯塔内斯科，帕夫莱娜（STANESKO, Pavlena）
阿列克谢·斯塔内斯科之妻。1929年1月9日，她在法公堂被控乞讨罪并受到警告。1936年11月14日，她因诈骗罪被提审至第一特区地方法院，并被判处拘留30天。（C.R.C. 第1271号）。

3. 斯塔内斯科，斯捷潘（STANESKO, Stepan）。音乐家。
他于1932年6月被工部局警务处逮捕，涉嫌与另一名吉普赛人共同实施诈骗（掉包计），但因证据不足而被释放。（娄扎 FIR 1300/32）。

page_data.en:
-2-

Stepan Stanesko and another gypsy named Alexander
MINASKO also came to the notice of this office in connection
with the notifications they published in the "Shun Pao" of
October 27, 1936 and in the "Min Pao" of February 5, 1937,
respectively, announcing their naturalization as Chinese
citizens.

Certified true copy
JHS.
page_data.zh:
-2-

斯捷潘·斯塔内斯科和另一名名为亚历山大·米纳斯科（Alexander MINASKO）的吉普赛人也引起了本处的注意，原因是他们分别在1936年10月27日的《申报》和1937年2月5日的《民报》上刊登公告，宣布归化为中国公民。

经核证无误之副本
JHS.

Police Headquarters.                      Macau, September 21, 1939.

No. 1319

Commissioner,
    Shanghai Municipal Police.
        Shanghai, China.

Sir,

            A group of artists of Russian nationality
who are inter-related arrived in Macau from Shanghai in
May this year.    They are provided with certificates
issued by the "Russian Emigrants Committee" of Shanghai
which were visaed by the British and Portuguese
Consulates of your city.
            These people now desire to return to
Shanghai.    Will you kindly inform me as to whether
there is any objection to their returning to Shanghai?
Besides the certificates they are also provided with
passports issued by the Chinese Government.

                                (signed)    Julio Montalvao e Silva,
                                            Commissioner of Police.

警察总局。                      澳门，1939年9月21日。

第 1319 号

致：
    上海公共租界工部局警务处总监。
        中国，上海。

先生，

            一群有亲属关系的俄罗斯籍艺人于今年五月从上海抵达澳门。他们持有由上海“俄罗斯移民委员会”签发的证书，并经贵市的英国和葡萄牙领事馆签证。
            这些人现在希望返回上海。恳请阁下告知，是否反对他们返回上海？除上述证书外，他们还持有中国政府签发的护照。

                                （签名）    胡里奥·蒙塔尔瓦奥·伊·席尔瓦，
                                            警察总监。
